name: pi-ark
description: Workspace-oriented web interface for the pi coding agent

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pi-ark/server" "npm run dev -w @pi-ark/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-ark/web && npm run build -w @pi-ark/server
scripts.check: npm run check -w @pi-ark/web && npm run check -w @pi-ark/server
scripts.check:behavior: tsx scripts/check-conversation.ts && tsx scripts/check-attachments.ts && tsx scripts/check-auth-flow.ts && tsx scripts/check-session-actions.ts && tsx scripts/check-system-prompt.ts && tsx scripts/check-files.ts && tsx scripts/check-instances.ts
